abstract.p: We describe a reproduction of a human annotation experiment that was performed to evaluate the effectiveness of text style transfer systems (Reif et al., 2022). Despite our efforts to closely imitate the conditions of the original study, the results obtained differ significantly from those in the original study. We perform a statistical analysis of the results obtained, discuss the sources of these discrepancies in the study design, and quantify reproducibility. The reproduction followed the common approach to reproduction adopted by the Re-proHum project (Belz et al., 2025).
